description: EVA operations values for the survival margin and two-person EVA (doc Proposal tab, 'Survival margin and two-person EVA', approved). Every value is quoted from the source PDF (text extracted and read); lunar documents, used for Mars as labelled ('Mars walk-back ranges are forward work').

conops.title: Exploration EVA System Concept of Operations, EVA-EXP-0042 Rev B

artemis_p1.title: Exploration EVA System Concept of Operations Summary for Artemis Phase 1 Lunar Surface Mission, EVA-EXP-0075

basalt.title: BASALT analog EVA operations (Astrobiology 19(3), 2019)
basalt.note: seen only as a search summary (publisher page returned 403); used only for the labelled 'analog practice' role split

eva_hours.label: Assumption (choice within the NASA range)
eva_hours.quote: The xEVA suit will support EVAs of up to 8 hours in duration (6±2 hours).

egress_ingress_h.label: NASA ConOps (Moon)
egress_ingress_h.quote: two to eight hours in duration (hour for egress/ingress and 1.5 - 7.5 hours of tasks)

emergency_extension_h.label: NASA ConOps (Moon)
emergency_extension_h.quote: EVAs may extend an additional hour for emergency and off- nominal situations.

rescue_limit_min.label: NASA ConOps (Moon)
rescue_limit_min.quote: The rescuer will need to be capable of getting the ICM into a safe haven (rover or habitat) within 60 minutes in an average thermally neutral environment.

single_rescuer.label: NASA ConOps (Moon)
single_rescuer.quote: there may be times where only one crewmember is available to perform the rescue

pairs.label: NASA ConOps (Moon)
pairs.quote: still enabling two crewmembers to act as buddies

mars.label: NASA ConOps
mars.quote: EVAs on Mars are still in work, but will likely have at least the frequency and duration of those for the sustained lunar missions in Artemis Phase 2.
mars.quote_walkback: Development of the mEMU and associated walk back ranges are forward work.

roles.ev1: leads the walk: navigation and the timeline
